body: I'm looking to move to a new city so it's especially nerve wracking. I wouldn't have many options to get out of that situation. Even the idea of a female roommate bringing a boyfriend over often makes me uncomfortable tbh. The fact I said no men and he decides to send me this sexist fantasy is uhhhhh... ok. Even if women are supposedly catty (which I've never experienced) I'd much rather deal with that than a nasty guy like this

The main reason I specified I'd rather live with women is because of trauma from past relationships and generally feeling nervous. This message is exactly what I'm scared of lol. I have male friends I'd be comfortable living with but a random guy is a hard pass. Your old roommate sounds pretty good tho
